en.headline: Two Hong Kong squash pairs reach Asian Games mixed doubles last four
en.dek: Lee Ka-yi and Tang Ming-hong, and Tse Yi-lam and Lai Cheuk-nam, both won their quarter-finals in straight games and are assured of medals.
body: Two Hong Kong mixed doubles pairs reached the Asian Games squash semi-finals on Friday in Nagoya, guaranteeing the city at least two medals in the event. Radio Television Hong Kong said there is no bronze-medal match, so both losing semi-finalists receive bronze.

Lee Ka-yi and Tang Ming-hong beat a Malaysian pair 11-7, 11-5. They will face India's Joshana Chinappa and Velavan Senthilkumar on Saturday morning for a place in the final. Tang had stepped into the partnership after Wong Chi-him withdrew with injury before the Games.

Tse Yi-lam and Lai Cheuk-nam, making their Asian Games debut as a pair, beat a Pakistani pair 11-6, 11-7. Both Hong Kong ties were completed in two games. The semi-finals are scheduled for Saturday morning.

zh.headline: 亞運壁球混雙兩對港組合闞四強 穩奪獎牌
zh.dek: 李嘉兒／鄧銘漮及謝依霖／黎卓楠周五在名古屋均直落兩局晉級，混雙不設銅牌戰，兩隊至少各得一面獎牌。
body: 港隊兩對壁球混雙組合周五於名古屋亞運闞四強，肯定為香港增添獎牌。港台報道，混雙項目不設銅牌戰，四強負方均可獲銅牌。
李嘉兒及鄧銘漮以11：7、11：5直落兩局擊敗馬來西亞組合，周六上午將對印度組合，爭入決賽。鄧銘漮於賽前接替因傷退賽的黃祁謙，與李嘉兒拍檔出戰。
首次以組合出戰亞運的謝依霖及黎卓楠，則以11：6、11：7直落兩局擊敗巴基斯坦組合。兩場四分之一決賽均在兩局內結束，準決賽定於周六上午舉行。
